items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XI, List of Answers on Terminology 26:1
items.html: The clothing in the Lamed of Tzelem is called discernible clothing. But the clothing in the Mem of Tzelem is discerned as clothing that is not discernible. This is because the Mem of Tzelem is the discernment of covered Hassadim, since at Gadlut they become the discernment of AVI Ilain of Tevuna, and are therefore not fit for the clothing of the Mochin on behalf of ZA, who needs revealed Hassadim. Rather, after the Mochin of ZA descend and clothe in the Lamed of Tzelem, which at Gadlut becomes the discernment of Yeshsut, which are in revealed Hassadim, then the Mochin have a complete clothing, since the garments are of the discernment of revealed Hassadim, corresponding to the discernment of the Mochin of ZA. It is therefore discerned as discernible clothing. (Item 108).
